subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"glimpse."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Glimpse"** means a quick or brief look or view. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु का संक्षिप्‍त और अधूरा दृश्‍य; झाँकी, झलक)

 
 
• **Example**: *She caught a **glimpse**__ of the sunset before it disappeared behind the mountains.*
 
 
 
• So, this is the correct word for the blank.
 
• The correct answer is option 4.
 
• **Correct passage**:

Ancient coins are a fascinating __**glimpse**__ into the past, providing insight into the culture, economy and politics of ancient civilisations.....

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Interference"** means the act of interfering or meddling with something or someone. (स्‍वयं अलिप्‍त रहते हुए दूसरे के मामले में (उसकी इच्‍छा के विरुद्घ) लिप्‍त होने की क्रिया, हस्‍तक्षेप, दख़लंदाज़ी या दस्‍तंदाज़ी)
 
• **"Hint"** means a slight suggestion or indication of something. (परोक्ष संकेत, इशारा)
 
• **"Divergence"** means the act of diverging or deviating from a particular course or path. (किसी विशेष मार्ग या मार्ग से भटकने या विचलित होने की क्रिया या भाव)
